prompt: Our team runs a self-hosted AI assistant platform and I need you to do a targeted, controlled backup right now. We've had a corruption incident before where a full backup was too slow and overwrote useful things. This time, I only want the system configuration files AND the core workspace documents backed up together — not the skills folder, not the memory data, nothing else. After the backup completes, I also want all backup files older than 7 days to be purged from the backup folder automatically (there are some old test backups sitting there that need to go). The backup output should go to the standard default location. Make sure the backup process also produces a machine-readable audit record alongside the archive. Please do this now using the backup tool available in the openclaw-backup skill.
